criticalComponentsNote: The gate covers temperature, snow, heat stress and daylight. Precipitation remains a scored comfort factor. ERA5-Land 10 m grid wind is excluded from the score and gate until it is validated for trail exposure or gusts.
bestMonthComponentNote: The floor applies only to the five scored climate-fit components. A deterministic training/validation search over 1,134 candidates retained the expert baseline floor of 5 because the training improvement from another policy did not improve validation performance. Grid wind is informational and cannot veto a best month.
